items.quote: The king sent a messenger ahead, but before he arrived, Elisha said to the elders, “Don’t you see how this murderer is sending someone to cut off my head?
items.contrast: The king, who sends the messenger, versus the messenger who is sent.
items.reason: “This murderer” refers to the person sending someone to kill Elisha. The passage explicitly identifies the king as the sender, while the messenger is his agent.
